introHtml: Hand wash only coffee mugs often feature specialty finishes like full-color wraps, metallic accents, or textured glazes that wouldn't survive a dishwasher cycle. These mugs are ideal for executive gifts or promotional giveaways where presentation matters more than convenience. Choose from ceramic options like the 15 oz Full Color Mug or the 14 oz Cork Base Ceramic Mug for a premium feel that recipients will hand-wash with care.
